purpose: One bounded, local-CPU, zero-cloud-cost, non-final M3.2 Scheme-D v4 engineering/statistical pilot. Structural reference only: scripts/m32_scheme_d_pilot_20260922 (v3 pilot, historical, unchanged).

bundle.statistic: FastMetric exact-equivalent to reference _metric; used unchanged

P1/C0.role: perturbed_null_type_one_false_positive_stress; every rejection is a false discovery; never power, never a true discovery, never evaluated with power/FDR criteria

injection_dispatch: scenario is not None (v4 runner run_cell and v4 shard layer make_evaluator); P1/C0 keeps injection

execution.network: blocked by the frozen runner's blocked_network() for every launcher command

runtime_estimate.basis: measured v4 benchmark 16406.782531828467 full-workload CPU-hours x 80 / 75000 worlds

outcome.effect_target_source: exactly V.INJECTIONS[106] = [0..7, 136..143, 272..279, 344..351]; evaluation is refused if the prespecified set differs

signed_target_lift_definition.name: composite_signed_target_lift
signed_target_lift_definition.per_world: for each non-world-refused P6/C4 receipt: tested targets = effect targets h not hypothesis-refused (str(h) not in receipt.refusals); each tested target must have a non-null signed_hex[h] (and each hypothesis-refused target a null one) or the input is refused; signed_effect = float.fromhex(signed_hex[h]) (exact binary64 decode); truth_sign = records[h].sign from the frozen P6/C4 truth table, whose records[h].classification must be analytic_non_null (else refuse); contribution = signed_effect * truth_sign; composite_signed_target_lift = arithmetic mean of contributions over tested targets; hypothesis-refused targets are excluded from that world's mean.
signed_target_lift_definition.per_world_counts: target_tested_count and target_refused_count are recorded for every non-world-refused world
signed_target_lift_definition.zero_testable_targets: if target_tested_count == 0 the world's pilot effect diagnostic is UNEVALUABLE (effect_status = UNEVALUABLE): it is not assigned zero, has no composite value, is excluded from the cell median and counts as neither positive nor non-positive. The counts of effect-evaluable and effect-unevaluable P6/C4 worlds are recorded. No new target-refusal threshold or STOP rule is introduced; the frozen world/hypothesis refusal rules and gates are unchanged.
signed_target_lift_definition.cell_statistic: median_signed_target_lift = statistics.median of per-world composite values across effect-evaluable P6/C4 worlds (none evaluable -> undefined; see rule 7a: never a negligible-effect STOP). Positive: composite > 0. Non-positive: composite <= 0.
signed_target_lift_definition.family_reporting: the four 8-target family means (0-7, 136-143, 272-279, 344-351; mean of contributions over that family's tested targets, null if none tested) are reported per world together with the across-world median of each family mean; they are descriptive only and add no decision gate
signed_target_lift_definition.nature: equal-weight, unstandardized, cross-family pilot diagnostic; NOT a formal Scheme-D effect-size statistic and not part of Scheme-D acceptance

outcome.rejecting_world_definition: non-refused world whose receipt has R > 0 (at least one BH rejection)
outcome.wilson: two-sided 95% Wilson score interval, Z = 1.959964 (identical to v4 acceptance.wilson)

rules.1_integrity_stop: STOP on any integrity failure: run_result overall integrity_stop or truth_table_refusal, invalid worker provenance, or more than one worker hardware identity. Tampered, incomplete, missing or mis-bound inputs are refused outright (no verdict).
rules.2_refusal_stop: STOP if, in any pilot cell, world refusal rate > 0.01 or hypothesis refusal rate > 0.01, using the unchanged v4 acceptance.refusal_blockers accounting
rules.3_null_perturbed_null_stop: applied to N0/C0, N3/C4 and P1/C0: STOP if rejecting_worlds / non_refused_worlds >= 0.25 (or non_refused_worlds == 0)
rules.4_p6_wrong_direction_stop: STOP if P6/C4 median signed target lift <= -0.01 AND at least 12 of its non-refused worlds have non-positive signed target lift
rules.5_p6_negligible_stop: STOP if the P6/C4 median signed target lift is defined and abs(median) < 0.01; never applied when no P6/C4 world is effect-evaluable (no median exists)
rules.6_go_candidate: GO if no STOP condition, P6/C4 median signed target lift >= 0.01 AND at least 12 of its non-refused worlds have positive signed target lift
rules.7a_p6_no_effect_evaluable_world: if zero P6/C4 worlds are effect-evaluable, any already-existing integrity/refusal STOP (rules 1-2) and null/perturbed-null STOP (rule 3) keeps precedence; otherwise the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (reason p6_no_effect_evaluable_worlds), never a negligible-effect STOP

outcome.p1_reporting: report P1/C0 rejecting-world count, rate and Wilson interval as a Type-I / false-positive stress diagnostic. 20 pilot worlds cannot establish the frozen protocol's final P1 Type-I/Wilson acceptance requirement (point <= 0.05 and Wilson upper <= 0.06; with 0/20 rejections the Wilson upper is ~0.161). The pilot criterion is diagnostic only.
outcome.significance: absence of statistical significance with 20 worlds is never, by itself, a STOP condition
outcome.comparability_note: cells, world indices and worker/shard sizes match the v3 pilot. The historical repository preserves the v3 verdict value 0.13311869 but not enough computation evidence to reconstruct its exact derivation; no claim is made that composite_signed_target_lift reproduces it, and the two values are not directly comparable.
